name: Only God Can Judge Me
overview: Scripture teaches that ultimate judgment belongs to God alone, cautioning believers against harsh or superficial condemnation of others, as seen in Jesus' commands to 'judge not, that ye be not judged' (Matthew 7:1) and to avoid judging by outward appearances but to practice righteous judgment (John 7:24). Believers are called to lovingly address sin within the community privately to restore relationships (Matthew 18:15) and to embody forgiveness, knowing that they too will receive mercy (Luke 6:37). While earthly judgment is limited, Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that all will face God’s final judgment after death, underscoring the need for faith and trust in Christ amid life's trials (John 14:1).
